items.title: First person charged in UK for 1994 Rwanda genocide
items.description: Vincent Brown, 65, was arrested and charged on Monday with one count of being an ancillary to genocide and six offences of aiding crimes against humanity in Rwanda.

items.title: How is Europe dealing with ‘hybrid war’?
items.description: European leaders accuse Russia of hybrid warfare.

items.title: Yemenis flee across Red Sea as Houthis and Saudi-backed forces escalate war
items.description: The BBC's Frank Gardner speaks to some of those who have fled the war by crossing the Red Sea to Djibouti.

items.title: Why gender-based violence persists in Southern Africa
items.description: A series of killings in South Africa has renewed scrutiny of efforts to combat violence against women. Activists say laws alone are not enough without effective implementation.

items.title: New U.S. Sanctions Will Harm Ukraine Peace Talks and Bilateral Ties, Kremlin Says
items.description: Without criticizing Donald Trump directly, Russian officials said the latest measures would only further strain relations.

items.title: West Bank: Israeli settler, Palestinian killed in latest violence
items.description: Violence flared in the Israeli-occupied West Bank on Sunday, as Israeli forces arrested a suspected Palestinian gunman accused of killing an Israeli man. In a separate incident, Israeli soldiers killed a Palestinian driver who the military said had attempted to run them over. Nicholas Rushworth reports.

items.title: ‘Nowhere is safe’: UN experts detail Ukraine war’s toll and Russia’s reach beyond its borders
items.description: UN Human Rights Council-appointed experts on Monday laid out a grim picture of the human cost of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine, with a spotlight on civilians facing a third wartime winter as well as the intimidation of Russians who have fled abroad.

items.title: Frontline Update, Lyman Details, AFU Reorganization
items.description: The front line has moved in Ukraine’s favor in the northern Lyman sector, whereas the southern city of Orikhiv, in the Zaporizhzhia region, is bracing itself for an expected Russian push. Meanwhile the Dopropillya sector remains one of the hottest, with the 1st Corps honing its drone buzz saw under serious pressure.

items.title: How Russia's parliamentary election might affect the war in Ukraine
items.description: NPR's Steve Inskeep asks Russian foreign policy expert Hanna Notte about the results of Russia's parliamentary election and what it means for Moscow's war in Ukraine.

items.title: Why Houthi offensive in Yemen has implications for Mideast and global trade
items.description: The Houthis in Yemen have captured strategic parts of the country, disrupting Saudi oil exports, threatening the global energy trade.

items.title: Trump Signs Russia-Iran Sanctions Bill, Putting New Pressure Tools At His Disposal
items.description: US President Donald Trump signed into law legislation aimed at increasing economic pressure on Russia over its war on Ukraine, including by targeting Moscow's energy revenues as well as countries that continue to buy Russian oil and gas.
